name: Mopinion
description_en:
Mopinion is a digital feedback service for websites, mobile apps and email. Its current official site says the name is evolving to Netigate Digital while the platform remains the same. This identity change should be preserved, without replacing the product with every capability in the wider Netigate suite.

The workflow adds contextual questions to digital touchpoints, then categorizes and routes the resulting feedback. It can help investigate why a user reports friction, complementing behavioral analytics rather than observing every visitor’s reason. Its subscription depends on channels and traffic volumes, despite unlimited feedback and surveys being advertised.
description_zh:
Mopinion 是面向网站、移动应用和邮件的数字反馈服务。当前官网明确名称正在变为 Netigate Digital，平台保持相同。应保留这项身份变化，不把更广 Netigate 套件所有能力替换进来。

其流程是在数字触点加入情境问题，再分类和分发反馈，可辅助调查用户报告摩擦的原因，补充行为分析，而不是观察每位访客的动机。虽然宣传无限反馈和问卷，订阅仍取决于渠道与流量。

core_features.explanation_zh: 在选定事件、行为或页面触发定制反馈。

core_features.name_en: Web, native app and email channels
core_features.name_zh: 网站、原生应用与邮件渠道
core_features.explanation_en: Website tag and iOS/Android SDK paths address different deployment contexts.
core_features.explanation_zh: 网站标签与 iOS／Android SDK 对应不同部署场景。

core_features.explanation_en: AI summaries, categorization, alerts, webhooks and integrations support follow-up.

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.

steps.en: For web feedback, implement the JavaScript tag in the page body or tag manager. Native apps use the mobile SDK. Configure when forms appear, who receives alerts and which report readers can see sensitive context. The service is SaaS, and the page states EU storage by default; confirm contractual requirements for your dataset. No self-hosted distribution or open-source license was established.
steps.zh: 网站反馈需把 JavaScript 标签放入页面 body 或标签管理器，原生应用则使用移动 SDK。配置表单触发时间、提醒接收者及敏感背景的报告读者。该服务为 SaaS，页面说明默认欧盟存储；具体数据要求需核对合同。未建立自托管发行或开源许可。

items.en: The FAQ states that after trial expiry the feedback inbox remains active, while reports go offline until upgrading. Monthly card customers can cancel, but annual plans are not refunded according to the page, and enterprise terms differ. Check reports and exports before cutover, and verify alert routing and SDK behavior on the intended platform. This may fit digital-experience teams; a long-form research questionnaire or recruited panel is a different primary task. Retry guarantees and exact SDK limitations were not tested.
items.zh: FAQ 说明试用到期后反馈收件箱仍活动，但报告会离线，升级后才可用。月付信用卡用户可取消；页面说明年付不退款，企业条款另有区别。切换前检查报告和导出，并在目标平台验证提醒分发与 SDK。它可适合数字体验团队；长问卷研究或招募样本是不同主要任务。重试保证与 SDK 具体限制未测试。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The calculator shows Standard from €279/month and Enterprise from €999 in one billing view, and €349/€1,199 in another. Monthly/discounted-annual controls coexist in the extracted page, so do not treat these as the same payable monthly bill. Price inputs include domains/pageviews, email brands/volume and apps/sessions. USD and GBP are indicative; charging follows the EUR exchange rate. Standard has a fourteen-day full-access trial without a card. Unlimited surveys and feedback do not mean unlimited traffic or free continued reports.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 计算器某视图列 Standard 每月 279 欧元起、Enterprise 999 起，另一视图为 349／1,199 欧元。提取页同时包含月付／折扣年付控件，不能当作相同的应付月账单。输入包括域名／浏览量、邮件品牌／数量、应用／会话。美元和英镑仅供参考，按欧元汇率收费。Standard 有十四天免信用卡全功能试用。问卷及反馈无限不代表流量无限或报告永久免费。

sections.title_en: Ask at checkout, then verify the reported problem
sections.title_zh: 在结账场景提问，再验证报告问题
sections.en: A proposed ecommerce implementation triggers a short form on an appropriate checkout event, records the page context and routes actionable comments to an owner. Compare those comments with analytics or a reproducible checkout test before declaring a root cause. Avoid repeatedly interrupting the same user and test the form’s effect on the underlying journey. A feedback response is a report from a responding user, not a census of everyone who abandoned.
sections.zh: 电商实施示例可在合适结账事件触发短表单，记录页面背景并将可操作评论交给负责人。宣称根因前，应结合分析数据或可重复结账测试验证。避免反复打断同一用户，并测试表单对原流程的影响。一份反馈只代表回答者，不是所有放弃用户的普查。
